label: step-001
payload: Write two files. 'catalog.py' — at least 100 lines, with a module docstring, an exported function 'load_all(path)' that reads entries, a local helper '_norm(entry)' used only inside 'catalog.py', and a few more documented functions. 'catalog_view.py' — imports 'catalog' and defines 'render(path)' which calls 'catalog.load_all'. Also write 'tests/test_catalog.py' covering 'load_all'.
